title: Samsung Just Made a 1,100Hz Monitor… at 720p?! 😬
description:
Samsung just made a gaming monitor that hits 1,100Hz — but there's a catch. 😬

The Samsung Odyssey G6 (G60H) is a 27-inch Fast IPS gaming monitor with Dual Mode: up to 1,100Hz in HD (1280×720), or up to 600Hz in QHD (2560×1440). At 1,100Hz each frame lasts under one millisecond, and gray-to-gray response is 1 ms.

The catch: the 1,100Hz mode only works at 720p — a quarter of QHD's pixels. LG already lists its 1080p UltraGear 25G590B at 1,000Hz native and 1,100Hz overclocked ($999.99). And Samsung hasn't announced a price or release date yet.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 42/100 → WRECK, for now. Wait for the price, unless you play shooters competitively.
